rows.grounds: kṛtena = by-done; instrumental singular neuter of kṛta (done).
yena = by-which; instrumental singular of relative pronoun ya.
devasya = of-deity; genitive singular masculine of deva.
sārūpyaṃ = same-form; accusative singular neuter of sārūpya.
yāti = goes; third person singular present active of √yā.
mānavaḥ = man; nominative singular masculine of mānava.
